Visit our three unique cinema venues.

SIFF Cinema offers year-round opportunities to discover extraordinary films from around the world at the SIFF Film Center, SIFF Cinema Uptown, and SIFF Cinema Downtown.

Venue Details Now Playing & Coming Soon

COMING SOON

Romería A beautifully rendered autobiographical tale and a touching portrait of family origins, following 18-year-old Marina as she travels to Vigo determined to uncover information on her father and learns the secrets that shaped her family.

Filipiñana At a picturesque upscale resort and golf club on the outskirts of Manila, 17-year-old tee-girl Isabel (Jorrybell Agoto) seeks out Dr. Palanca, the club's president, to return a misplaced golf club, but unexpectedly uncovers a series of dark truths about her workplace, elite members, and her own past.

100 Years of the Uptown: Faust with The Invincible Czars The Invincible Czars celebrate 100 years of the silent masterpiece Faust (1926, FW Murnau). Their brand new electrifying score marries new and old elements of classical music, bossa nova and even a touch of heavy metal to bring the movie to life for contemporary audiences and incorporates a mix of instruments like flute, violin and electric guitar.

American Doctor Three courageous doctors—a Jewish orthopedic surgeon from North Carolina, a Zoroastrian trauma surgeon from California, and a Palestinian American ER specialist from Illinois—volunteer their services in Gaza, risking their lives to save others.

The American Astronaut (35mm) Samuel Curtis, an interplanetary trader, sets forth through a rustic and remote solar system, unaware that his old friend Professor Hess is trying to kill him. A rare 35mm print of this 2001 space western musical.

Tony A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.
